# NextDue

> NextDue is a private, offline-first iOS bill tracker. Track due dates, mark payments, and see upcoming bills on a home-screen widget — no account needed.

NextDue helps people track recurring bills and subscriptions entirely on-device. There is no account, no server sync, and no analytics tracking individual users. Core features: due-date tracking, quick bill entry, payment history, custom categories, home-screen widgets, light and dark mode, and bill scanning from a photo.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nextdueapp.vercel.app/): Product overview, features, screenshots, and App Store link.
- [Privacy Policy](https://nextdueapp.vercel.app/privacy.html): Data handling and privacy details.
